meta.title: AQA GCSE English Language Mock Paper Bank
meta.subtitle: Original AQA-style GCSE English Language practice papers with secure OpenAI-assisted marking
notes: All sources, extracts and questions are original mock materials and are not official AQA papers.
Each generated paper contains four questions worth 4, 8, 20 and 40 marks and is designed for 1 hour 25 minutes.
The browser saves the selected paper pack and student responses locally on that device.

questions.instructionsTop: Read again the first part of Source A, lines 1 to 4.
questions.questionText: Choose four statements below which are TRUE.

rubric.name: AO1 selection
rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each correct statement chosen, up to 4 marks. No explanation is required.

options: A. The harbour appears gradually out of the fog.
B. The water is shining brightly in the sun.
C. A bell is striking somewhere beyond the water.
D. The pier posts are black and wet with rain.
E. Mara is running along the pier.
F. Ropes knock softly against wooden masts.
G. A crowd is waiting by the harbour wall.
H. Boats are already leaving the harbour.
